anchors.paper_title: By Carrot or by Stick: Cognitive Reinforcement Learning in Parkinsonism
anchors.reason: The candidate paper discusses general cognitive reinforcement learning in Parkinsonism, which is topically related to the dataset's mood manipulation task, but does not describe or introduce this specific dataset.

metadata.methods_description: EEG data were collected from 50 healthy controls (25 following sad mood manipulation, 25 following happy mood manipulation) during a reinforcement learning task adapted from Daw et al. (2006). The task included training and testing sections with mood manipulation administered before each training block. Data collection occurred at the Cognitive Rhythms and Computation Lab at the University of New Mexico between 2019-2021.
